# Skill2Poster v0.1.0

First public release focused on discoverability and reuse.

## Included

- Two Codex skills:
  - `paper-poster-imagegen`
  - `academic-poster-builder`
- Example poster outputs in `assets/`.
- GitHub Pages landing page with SEO metadata, Open Graph tags, sitemap, and robots file.
- Repository metadata guidance for description, homepage, and topics.
- Share kit for linking to Skill2Poster from external pages.
- Example paper citation and BibTeX.

## Example Paper

The example poster images use the following paper as the demonstration subject:

- *From Off-Policy to On-Policy: Enhancing GUI Agents via Bi-level Expert-to-Policy Assimilation*
- arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05787
- BibTeX: `references/from-off-policy-to-on-policy.bib`

## Verification

- GitHub Pages landing page renders at https://leon-gittech.github.io/Skill2Poster/
- `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` are available from the Pages site.
- README and repository metadata include academic-poster and paper-to-poster search terms.
